name: UNE Student Emergency Assistance Fund
summary: Quick-response one-off grants for UNE students whose financial hardship is affecting their studies.
who: Currently enrolled in a degree or course at UNE (not UNE staff)
how: Talk with UNE Life Student Advocacy and Welfare, then submit the application form with supporting documents
catches: One application per student in a 12-month period
Grants may not cover the full cost of the expense

source.label: University of New England: Student Emergency Assistance Funds

evidence.quote: quick response grants for UNE students experiencing financial hardship.
Open to all students currently enrolled in a degree/course at UNE, excluding UNE staff members.
N/A - Applications may be submitted year-round.
